structural_change: SQK-CB16C 10-21 rgxd (FALLBACK, gated with rgxc): = rgxc plus (a) PIN PLAN: each N/S data bus (bco0-3, rs_i, bc0-3, rs, rs_o) re-centred directly over its pin-register station at 4 pins/um (129 / 128.5 um, was 172 um offset up to 340 um from the station) so the unregistered IO leg is the face gap + <= 65 um lateral (die pin plan for cluster parents is assigned top-down by the die tools); (b) clock stages finer: OT_CKR_STEP_UM 30, OT_CKR_SEG_UM 120, OT_CKR_DMAX_UM 150 (less wire per stage). 0 cycles, no RTL change. SQK-CB16C 10-21 rgxc (rgxb successor; rgxb gate ep9 053531: TT setup -583 ps at u_ft_0/d = rs_i IO leg into the pin-register station, FF hold -281 ps between neighbouring c2r1 reset relays; cb16_ckkm balanced TT to 25.8 ps with 25,782 pads on trees of 1.06-2.52 ns native insertion that cross the A0 macros unbuffered -> wire-dominated, splits ~400 ps at FF / with RC model). (1) CLOCK: tools/qwen_cluster/cb16_km/cb16_ckring.tcl replaces cb16_ckkm: per region a buffered trunk (BUFx4 every 40 um) along channels from the port to a ring around that region's A0 (A0 + 43.2 um, inside the channels), two buffered chains around the ring, every sink (scalar FFs + A0 / station / ring / xstn clock pins) grouped by (160-um ring segment, 30-ps child-insertion bin) under a local root tapped from the nearest chain buffer; TritonCTS builds only the local trees; pads use the SAME buffer laid out as 40-um hops -> every clock path is the same buffer+wire stage repeated (TT and FF scale together); global alignment to the latest group of all 16 ports (hardened landing rings read single-cycle). The 4 interior-column region clock ports (ck_c1r1/c2r1/c1r2/c2r2) move from mid-row (over the edge-column A0) into the horizontal channels so their trunks never cross a macro. (2) IO: ring_tile_place_b.py OT_RTPB_IO_REACH_UM=180 (u_dn2_exit 270: xstn->rly10->exit chain bound) re-places the 11 pin-register stations (and 29 others) so every port->station IO leg is <= 180 um (rgxb 212-394), all hard hops / ring legs still <= 405, 0 cycles, no RTL change. Prior: QW-CB16REG 10-20 main line (a): CB16 parent with every region crossing HARDENED -- 69 qfd_c_ring516/514 tiles (writer ring on the source region clock + reader incl. output register on the destination clock, one tile per crossing, 2 masters hardened once) replace the 138 soft ring halves (161k flops) of qfd_c_b16_fulln; each region root now reaches only hard-child clock pins (A0, stations, xstn, ring tiles) + the scalar control / reset FFs, balanced by cb16_ckkm.tcl.  Ring tiles placed by tools/qwen_cluster/ring_tile_place.py (CP-SAT, 43.2 lattice, writer anchors -> tile in face and tile out face -> reader anchors <= 405 um planned; 0 crossings planned above 405 with repeaters: {}; 40 relay stations re-placed (ring_tile_place_b.py, hard hops <= 405, 0 cycles)).  RTL qfd_c_b16_rgx.sv (qc_ring_parent.py) = qfd_c_b16_fullm with the soft pairs replaced; same ports / stations / A0 / xstn / res
